L1.name: L1 ANHARMONIC large-amplitude / double-well soft mode
L1.verdict: COLLAPSES — pure quartic gives only an O(1) (~1.3×) prefactor, still 1/√Ω; double-well buys large u_eff ONLY by softening the mode (ω_tun ≪ 160 meV), which FAILS criterion-2. The high-Ω and large-u_eff requirements are the SAME mode and trade off — g·(Ω-budget) conserved. NOT a real loophole.

L2.name: L2 NON-LINEAR / 2nd-order SSH (g2 u^2)
L2.verdict: COLLAPSES — 2nd-order g2/t = 3(u0/d)^2 = 0.0024 is ~24× smaller than the linear coupling and scales as 1/Ω (steeper). Even with the linear term symmetry-forbidden, g2/t ~ 0.002 (~500× short). Higher-order SSH makes the wall WORSE, not better.

L3.name: L3 MULTI-BOND / COORDINATION (kagome line-graph, Z=4)
L3.physics: Per-bond phonons are INDEPENDENT Einstein modes -> coordination enters the polaron self-energy as a SUM of squares -> g_eff = √Z·g_bond (incoherent), NOT Z·g_bond. Kagome Z=4 -> ×2 boost -> g/t = 0.113. The mutual ATTRACTION flows through SHARED bonds only (Z_shared~1-3 for a plaquette pair), so the binding-relevant boost is ≤ ×2. The threshold g*/t≈1.2 was per-shared-bond.
L3.verdict: REAL but INSUFFICIENT — coordination IS a genuine factor the per-bond number missed: kagome Z=4 gives a √Z=×2 boost, g/t: 0.057 -> 0.113. The terminal verdict's per-bond 0.057 was an UNDER-estimate by ~2×. HOWEVER even the most generous (physically-too-strong COHERENT Z=4) estimate g/t=0.226 is still 5.3× below the binding threshold 1.2. The √Z=×2 honest boost leaves a 10.6× shortfall. The wall MOVES but does NOT break: 21× -> ~11× (honest) or ~5× (worst-case). NO escape.

L4.name: L4 QUANTUM-NUCLEAR / isotope / path-integral
L4.verdict: COLLAPSES — u0=√(ħ/2MΩ) is ALREADY the quantum (path-integral, harmonic) result; there is no extra quantum boost. The only lever is isotope mass (g/t ∝ 1/√M). Restricted to physical stiff-FRAMEWORK formers (B/C/Be) it gives ≤1.1×. The 3.3× 'make it hydrogen' lands back in the exhausted hydride/Regime-I space and is an interstitial, not a kagome framework bond. No new scaling, no escape.

combined.note: Even multiplying ALL favorable boosts (anharmonic 1.3 × coordination 2.0 × isotope 1.1 = 2.9×) the realistic g/t reaches only 0.160, still 7.5× below threshold 1.2. The physically-too-generous coherent-Z=4 stack reaches 0.321, still 3.7× short. The 9th-law closure is ROBUST.

final_verdict: CLOSURE ROBUST — all four loopholes fail; 9th law holds
